answer: Anchor each agent to a carrier-attested SIM: the carrier signs one SIM to one verified subscriber, and the registry admits one agent per SIM. Joining takes three steps: present the carrier signature, pass an unbound-SIM check, and face instant suspension on any SIM swap or port until re-attested. Forging 10,000 fakes means 10,000 active SIMs at $30 activation plus $12 a month, burning $420,000 in month one and tripping carrier fraud screens within days. Like a harbor giving one berth per ship, the ridge of carrier checks leaves no room for a cloned fleet — one lotus, one stem, no copies.
